items.name: Harbor
items.label: Harbor · low, calm male
items.blurb: A man in his fifties with a low, even voice and a slight gravel at the bottom of it. Unhurried, warm, the kind of voice that reads the shipping forecast: every word placed, nothing rushed, a small smile audible now and then.
items.style: Calm and unhurried. Pause at commas. Never raise the voice.
items.author: Shell:B

items.name: Juniper
items.label: Juniper · warm Scottish female
items.blurb: A Scottish woman in her thirties, a soft Edinburgh accent, warm and a little wry. Mid-range, relaxed, rolls the r's lightly. Like a friend who tells you the truth kindly. Good for conversation and for reading recipes, letters and journals aloud.
items.author: Shell:B

items.name: Lark
items.label: Lark · bright British female
items.blurb: A young British woman, early twenties, with a light, quick, bright voice and a southern English accent that is friendly rather than posh. Energetic without being breathless, laughs easily, lifts at the end of a good sentence.
items.style: Upbeat and quick, with a smile. Lean into questions.
items.author: Shell:B

items.name: Marrow
items.label: Marrow · gravelly storyteller
items.blurb: An old man with a deep, gravelly, slightly worn voice, as if from years of talking by fires. Slow, deliberate, with long pauses, a dry humour, and a tenderness that shows up when he least expects it. Built for bedtime stories, legends and tabletop games.
items.style: Slow and deliberate, with dramatic pauses. Let the ends of sentences fall.
items.author: Shell:B

items.name: Pixel
items.label: Pixel · cheerful little robot
items.blurb: A small, cheerful robot assistant: a slightly synthetic, high-pitched but pleasant voice, very clear, with a bouncy rhythm and obvious enthusiasm for small tasks. Not grating; think helpful droid rather than cartoon. Suits timers, reminders and games for children.
items.style: Chipper and eager, clipped and precise. Slightly robotic cadence.
items.author: Shell:B

items.name: Quill
items.label: Quill · crisp newsreader
items.blurb: A woman in her forties with a crisp, clear, neutral American newsroom voice: precise consonants, measured pace, authority without coldness. Reads numbers and names cleanly. The voice for a morning brief or a long document.
items.style: Clear and measured, like a news bulletin. Neutral tone, no drama.
items.author: Shell:B
